items.headline: Viktor Hovland Withdraws
items.text: Viktor Hovland announced his first withdrawal of 2026 following a missed cut at the PGA Championship, adding to a difficult season.

items.headline: LIV Criticized on Prep
items.text: Criticism mounts that LIV Golf leaves players like Bryson DeChambeau and Jon Rahm less prepared for major championships such as the upcoming US Open.
